import json
import sys
from unittest import mock

from operation_graph_optimization import benchmark, graph

original_column = graph.Graph._column
statistics = {
    "column_calls": 0,
    "allocations": 0,
    "evictions": 0,
    "byte_pressure_calls": 0,
    "target_pressure_calls": 0,
    "peak_bytes": 0,
    "peak_targets": 0,
    "final_bytes": 0,
    "final_targets": 0,
}


def measured_column(instance, previous, following):
    before = len(instance._columns)
    allocation = previous not in instance._columns
    old_length = len(instance._columns.get(previous, b""))
    remaining_count = before - (not allocation)
    required = max(old_length, following - previous + 1)
    if remaining_count:
        statistics["byte_pressure_calls"] += instance._column_bytes - old_length + required > instance._cache_bytes
        statistics["target_pressure_calls"] += remaining_count >= instance._cache_targets
    column = original_column(instance, previous, following)
    statistics["column_calls"] += 1
    statistics["allocations"] += allocation
    statistics["evictions"] += before + allocation - len(instance._columns)
    statistics["peak_bytes"] = max(statistics["peak_bytes"], instance._column_bytes)
    statistics["peak_targets"] = max(statistics["peak_targets"], len(instance._columns))
    statistics["final_bytes"] = instance._column_bytes
    statistics["final_targets"] = len(instance._columns)
    return column


with mock.patch.object(graph.Graph, "_column", autospec=True, side_effect=measured_column):
    benchmark.main(args=sys.argv[1:], standalone_mode=False)
print(json.dumps({"diagnostics": statistics}), flush=True)
